answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake reputation earned through verifiable work, not just tokens: a new identity starts with zero trust, and every attested task adds a small, decaying endorsement from established peers. One fake account's lies ripple outward and get checked against its neighbors, so creating many cheap identities costs more than it gains. Like water filtering through karst, trust seeps slowly through real connections - no shortcut reaches the summit of full standing without a history of honest work.
